description.description: A low-angle color photograph shows the four members of the Beatles - Ringo Starr, Paul McCartney, George Harrison, and John Lennon - looking down over a wooden railing inside the EMI headquarters in London. They are all sporting long hair and facial hair, dressed in late 1960s attire. This image recreates the shot from their first album, 'Please Please Me', and was used for their '1967-1970' compilation album.
